title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: Who do you look up to most?
I admire her because she is brave and kind.
sentences.zh: 我敬佩她，因为她勇敢又善良。

sentences.en: Marie Curie won the Nobel Prize twice.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·居里两次获得诺贝尔奖。

sentences.en: Amelia Earhart flew across the Atlantic Ocean alone.
sentences.zh: 阿梅莉亚·埃尔哈特独自飞越了大西洋。

sentences.en: Zhang Qian was a pioneer of the Silk Road.
sentences.zh: 张骞是丝绸之路的开拓者。

sentences.en: She did not drop out of school, and she never gave up.
sentences.zh: 她没有辍学，也从不放弃。

sentences.en: Above all, we need courage and wisdom.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我们需要勇气和智慧。

sentences.en: Great people leave good ideas behind for mankind.
sentences.zh: 伟人给人类留下了好思想。

sentences.en: His ideas will live on forever.
